shellCommands.command:
/bin/bash -c "set -eu
printf 'GET shelf: '; curl -sS -o /tmp/reading-room-books.json -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:4317/api/books
cat /tmp/reading-room-books.json
printf '\\nPOST book: '; curl -sS -o /tmp/reading-room-created.json -w '%{http_code}\\n' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"title\":\"The Left Hand of Darkness\",\"author\":\"Ursula K. Le Guin\",\"notes\":\"A thought about winter and kinship.\"}' http://localhost:4317/api/books
cat /tmp/reading-room-created.json
book_id="'$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('"'fs').readFileSync('/tmp/reading-room-created.json')).id)\")
printf '\\nGET direct link route: '; curl -sS -o /tmp/reading-room-route.html -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:4317/books/"'$book_id
printf '"'GET detail API: '; curl -sS -o /tmp/reading-room-detail.json -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://localhost:4317/api/books/"'$book_id
printf '"'\\nPATCH finish: '; curl -sS -o /tmp/reading-room-finished.json -w '%{http_code}\\n' -X PATCH -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"status\":\"finished\"}' http://localhost:4317/api/books/"'$book_id
cat /tmp/reading-room-finished.json
printf '"'\\nPersisted JSON: '; cat data/books.json
"
/bin/bash -c 'git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- package.json && cat data/books.json && node --check server.js && node --check app.js'

/bin/bash -c "rg -n '\"start\"|\"dev\"|function renderShelf|form.addEventListener|const server =|<header class=\"topbar\"|\\.welcome \\{' package.json app.js server.js index.html styles.css && cat data/books.json && git status --short"
